environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL. The function URL resource policy includes a condition key 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' set to 'AWS_IAM' on the function URL configuration (not on the resource-based policy principal). The URL config object has AuthType=AWS_IAM which requires Sigv4-signed requests; unsigned HTTP requests receive a 403 response from the Lambda service frontend before the function is invoked. Note: the function's resource-based policy still contains a statement with Principal='*' for legacy CloudWatch synthetic monitoring, but this principal statement applies to the lambda:InvokeFunction action scoped to a specific source ARN (synthetics canary), not to lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl. The IAM auth requirement on the URL is evaluated by the Lambda URL service independently of resource-based invoke policies.
